decisions.fabric_requirement: 1.5m of silk, 0.75m of velvet, 2m of lace

commitments.detail: Payment of $1000 due upon completion of the costume.
Suppliers to provide 1.5m of silk, 0.75m of velvet, and 2m of lace.
Costume to be delivered by October 20, 2023, at 18:00 UTC.
Fitting session scheduled for October 15, 2023, at 14:00 UTC.
